title: Clippy
description: Self-hosted RAG chatbot answering questions from internal documentation.
summary: A lightweight RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) chatbot that answers technical questions from internal documentation and ops knowledge. Markdown docs are embedded with HuggingFace models and stored in a local Chroma vector database; queries combine vector and keyword search before top hits are sent as context to a locally hosted Llama 3.1 model via Ollama. Runs entirely on internal infrastructure — no external API calls — so sensitive information never leaves the network. Deployed on an OpenStack VM with GPU access and served through a FastAPI/Uvicorn backend.
